description: Multi-phase plans currently in flight. Each phase references roadmap item ids; the activePhase section breaks the current phase into concrete tasks with status. Survives conversation compactions — a fresh session can pick up by reading this file.

phases.title: Sources and roadmap intake: ADO + GitHub Issues, plugin seam for Jira

activePhase.title: Sources and roadmap intake: ADO + GitHub Issues, plugin seam for Jira
activePhase.goal: Build edict 0011 (as amended 2026-10-14) to its acceptance criteria, offline, in a worktree, ending in a PR with Momus's review.
activePhase.sequencing: Night shift 2026-10-14/15, unattended. Work in a worktree on feat/0011-sources from main. Order (Momus F14): T-s1 schema registry -> T-s2 proposal kinds -> T-s3 roadmap storage -> T-s4 plugin interface + GitHub -> T-s5 ADO (synthetic, unverified; Kohl finishes it live at work) -> T-s6 write-back + doctor -> T-s7 Momus + PR -> T-s8 dream. PR #44 (doctor.py C# checks) merged as cb62046; still put source checks in their own function after run_checks. Never: live sync, real gh/keyring calls in tests, push to main, edit edicts. If the edict is unclear, write a dissent or a note in the PR and skip that part; don't guess.
